/**发行登记未报送的数据*/ with pi as ( select prod_id ,count(1) send_counts from chb_prd_issue_sub where SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS ='03' and status!='04' group by prod_id )
select r.prod_id prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno,nvl(pi.send_counts,0) regcounts from chb_prd_raisetot_sub r left join pi on r.prod_id=pi.prod_id where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) and to_char(r.STATUS_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=to_char(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')

with /**产品存续期交易：银行实际收益之和*/ pp as ( select to_char(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyymm') termid ,sum(nvl(BANK_IMP_INT,0)) bank_profit1 from chb_prd_deal_sub d left join chb_prd_baseinfo i on d.prod_id=i.prod_id and i.operate_mode in ('01','02') where d.status!='04' and d.STATUS_DATE<=#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE} )
,pm as( select d.termid,sum(bankprofit ) bank_profit2,m.reportuuid from chb_month_report_detail d left join chb_month_report m on d.termid = m.termid where d.termid=to_char(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyymm') and d.propertycode in ( 'GMLCCP','SMLCCP') group by d.termid,m.reportuuid )
select pm.termid ,pm.reportuuid registseqno ,nvl(pp.bank_profit1,0) bankprofit1 ,nvl(pm.bank_profit2,0) bankprofit2 from pp,pm where pp.termid=pm.termid
